description.en:
Shows or hides a named caption.
Captions made by the CMND_2DO_CREATE_*_TELOP functions start hidden (the engine calls this same visibility switch with false right after creating them), so a script must call this with true before the caption appears.
true to show the caption, false to hide it (any non-zero value counts as true).

null if the engine is not ready, fewer than 2 arguments were given, or no caption has that name.
On success the native reports a result without pushing one, so Squirrel hands back the last argument (the visible value).

examples.case: Revealing captions after creating them (real usage, from ie4_soccer_sys.nut; caption names shortened from the script's Shift-JIS names)
Hiding a caption without deleting it
examples.code:
// Hide the caption for now; it can be shown again later by name.
CMND_2DO_STATE_DRAW_TELOP("tactic_0", false);
